definitions.explanation: Commercial activity of buying and selling.
The activity of selling products or services.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{時間|じかん}は9{時|じ}からです。
{営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work in the sales department.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}{営業|えいぎょう}{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: We are open for business today.

notes:
{営業|えいぎょう} relates to business operations and sales.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}する (to do business, to sell)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{中|ちゅう} (open for business)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{時間|じかん} (business hours)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ} (sales department)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{マン|まん} (salesperson)

OPPOSITE:
- {休業|きゅうぎょう}: closed for business
